seo_desc: Village Pizza & Grill, 116 Main Street, Ashland NH. Greek and Italian family restaurant. Call (603) 968-9689.
about: Village Pizza & Grill is a family Greek and Italian restaurant at 116 Main Street in Ashland, New Hampshire.
menu_note: The shop's takeout menu is a PDF on its own website (villagepizzaashland.com). This concept does not reproduce it: call (603) 968-9689 for items and prices.
findings: Hand-built one-page site from about 2019 (footer '© Parkview Pizza LLC', designer credit mjcamara.com).
About text is out of date ('over 13 years', new owners 'as of December 2018'); this concept does not repeat it.
No online ordering, only a phone number, shown as 1-603-968-9689.
Long text-only menu; the printable PDF menu was last modified May 2023.
Photo carousel images use placeholder alt text ('img 1') and raw camera file names.
questions: Would you like online ordering? If so, through which service?
